question: Th which year was the High Court of Delhi established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1966.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The** **High Court of Delhi:**

 
 
• By virtue of the Delhi High Court Act, 1966, the Delhi High Court was** founded on October 31, 1966.**
 
• **Its first four judges were Chief Justice K.S. Hegde,** Justice I. D. Dua, Justice H.R. Khanna, and Justice S.K. Kapur.
 
• The Delhi High Court is the highest court in the NCT of Delhi that exercises state-level judicial functions.
 
• Subordinate Courts operate for nine judicial districts, including Central, New Delhi, South, North, West, East, and South-West. They are located below it.
 
• The highest court of a state is the Delhi High Court.
 
• **It derives its authority from Chapter V of Part VI of the Indian Constitution.**
